metadata.case_name: YEUNG KAI MING v. WAH KEE METAL

injuries.description: parts of the index ... finger were amputated
source: He was taken to Queen Mary Hospital where parts of the index and middle fingers were amputated the same day.

The right index finger is 1-3/8" long ... X-ray shows that in the index finger, the amputation is through the middle phalanx, but so close close to the proximal interphalangeal joint that it is equivalent to amputation at the joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

injuries.description: parts of the middle ... finger were amputated
source: He was taken to Queen Mary Hospital where parts of the index and middle fingers were amputated the same day.

In the middle finger, the terminal phalanx is missing. Actually there is a sliver of the distal phalanx present in the middle finger but the remnant is so small that it can have no function and is too small for the attachment of either the extensor or flexor tendons ...
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

manifestations.description: intense pain at the time of the accident
continued pain in the stumps; pain in the stumps when knocked
reduced grip strength in the right hand (exercises a 37 lb. grip with the right hand and an 80 lb. grip with the left)
difficulty in loading and unloading goods quickly, and in securing the goods to the lorry with ropes
more limited in his choice of jobs, being no longer able to do work involving manual dexterity such as threading work which he had done in a textile mill

losses.description: Reduced grip strength in the right hand; numbness and pain in the stumps following amputation of parts of the index and middle fingers.
More limited in his choice of jobs, being no longer able to do work involving manual dexterity such as threading work which he had done in a textile mill.
Diminished prospects of marriage from both the cosmetic and economic viewpoints as a result of his injuries.
Plaintiff claimed that his injury had affected his social life.

comparable_cases.injury_description: injury and the relatively quick recovery were both similar
injuries were similar and the victim was sent home the same day
injuries which were similar, although more serious and involving more arduous treatment
hand injuries which were considerably more serious and again involved more treatment
